summary: Prove fetched Poisson cell contractions against byte-backed TorchLean matrix products

examined.reason: New local fetched-block correctness, execution existence and matrix-layout theorems connect actual byte loads to TorchLean. The supplied shared snapshot and missing gather/control/stores/barriers are explicit; no full cell or solver claim.
Parent now identifies the eight local cell contractions as proved block contracts while preserving outstanding parallel phase and whole-kernel obligations.

The explicit dependency audit expands to cover every new public declaration. Standard-axiom-only acceptance and the separate source-fidelity, textual-binding, compiler and GPU boundaries remain unchanged.
The reference solver, represented equations, residual certificate and empirical backend behavior are unchanged. This is an additional partial instruction proof.

results.method: integration/torchlean/check.sh; python3 -m unittest discover -s hardware -p test_*.py; hardware/check_poisson_contractions.py and hardware/check_poisson_ptx.py on .hardware-runs/poisson-certified; pinned PTX 9.4 semantic review; stratic validate; local guide links; git diff --check; distribution guard
results.environment: Pinned Lean 4.34.0 and existing checked dependencies. No external model calls or new GPU execution. Source version 9.4 with pinned SHA-256; saved emitted artifacts include the reviewed 9.2 variant.
results.evidence: Full integration passed 2861 exact dependency reports, only standard Lean axioms. All 24 Python tests passed. Fresh binding checked 720 contraction blocks in 30 saved layouts and retained the 30-layout residual binding. Four contraction endpoints freshly audited in the binding checker; all 69 new declarations independently audited and included in the full audit. Receipt source hashes match final files. Source/config/receipts unchanged from precheck tree 0eeee741727cec740f4c6e89fa854c437d9e942a; only the new study guide gained plain-English explanations afterward, manually reviewed with 28 local guide links verified. Stratic validation and whitespace checks pass. Source interpretation and theorem review preserve the supplied-snapshot local scope: full cell control, gather, stores, weights, final addition, barriers, memory admission and solver composition remain open.
